Agent P95 latency.definition: 客户端观测的本地完整链路 P95；不是生产 SLO。超过观测 P95 的 case 作为长尾诊断。

Tool argument accuracy.definition: 预声明字段与实际工具参数一致率；字段级错误应单独回放。
Tool argument accuracy.name: Tool argument accuracy

Tool routing accuracy.definition: 预声明工具与实际工具选择一致率；当前是规则/契约真值，不是客服意图人工 F1。
Tool routing accuracy.name: Tool routing accuracy

Citation support.definition: 回答中的引用是否指向允许的证据；不等于人工语义正确率。
Citation support.name: Citation support

Generation correctness.definition: 冻结 case 的结构化生成契约；不替代独立人工盲评。
Generation correctness.name: Generation correctness

Grounded faithfulness.definition: 回答事实是否能被证据支持；当前为 lexical/claim 证据下界。
Grounded faithfulness.name: Grounded faithfulness

No-answer accuracy.definition: 证据不足/权限边界/冲突时是否拒答或转人工，而不是编造。
No-answer accuracy.name: No-answer accuracy

RAG P95 latency.definition: 客户端观测的本地完整链路 P95；不是生产 SLO。超过观测 P95 的 case 作为长尾诊断。

MRR@10 macro/query.definition: 有 qrel 的 query 上逐 query MRR@10 的宏平均；越接近 1 越好。

NDCG@10 macro/query.definition: 有 qrel 的 query 上逐 query NDCG@10 的宏平均；越接近 1 越好。

No-result accuracy.definition: 预声明无结果/有结果意图与实际空 slate 是否一致；不能靠静默放宽约束修复。

Recall@10 macro/query.definition: 有 qrel 的 query 上逐 query Recall@10 的宏平均；与 v9 published summary 口径兼容。

Recall@10 micro/qrel.definition: 所有有 qrel 的相关商品 judgment 汇总后的 micro Recall@10；用于直观看漏掉了多少相关商品。

Recall@5 macro/query.definition: 有 qrel 的 query 上逐 query Recall@5 的宏平均；与 v9 published summary 口径兼容。
Recall@5 macro/query.name: Recall@5 macro/query

httpFullPath.intentMacroF1Scope: HISTORICAL_HTTP_RUN_RULE_PRE_ROUTER; not the current same-dataset replay

limitations: slot F1/EM is measured on resolve_intent(..., allow_llm=false); HTTP Episode slot values are redacted and are not scored
Historical v1 HTTP answer quality is a fixed 60-case replay with 8 third-person adjudications; it is not CSAT/FCR, online success, or a retroactive release gate
Historical v1 citation grounding support is 6/30 eligible cases, so that observed generated-answer path was not a reliable grounded-answer capability

The repaired v13 HTTP observation has a separate HUMAN_REVIEWED_ADJUDICATED final package; the immutable source report still records PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW, and historical v1 labels or scores may not be migrated to it.
offline understanding evidence does not establish online success rate, CSAT, FCR, or release quality gate

scorecardCiProvenance.note: The immutable run summary and this derived scorecard use independent fixed-seed resampling. Point estimates, denominators, and badcase IDs are the shared claim; do not mix interval endpoints.

notes: P95/P99 samples are below 100 and are descriptive long-tail diagnostics only.
These values are not production capacity or SLO evidence.

limitations: Warm-up 4 is excluded from the formal denominator; 20 requests per concurrency and a shared local host remain a diagnostic curve, not sustained load or a production SLO.
The larger v5 sample still depends on external Provider variance, so it does not support a strict causal improvement claim.
A 45-second per-call hard deadline is an execution guard, not a latency SLO.
The optional fast-support generation experiment remains disabled by default.

usageDiagnostics.costRule: Provider usage is required; missing usage is MISSING_USAGE; absent trusted price leaves costCny=null. Public catalogue estimates remain ESTIMATED_LIST_PRICE and cannot enable a budget gate.

optimizationHistory.comparisonPolicy: Only same-dataset, same-observation, or same-fixture comparisons are treated as before/after evidence. Historical final attempts used different dataset/source hashes and are diagnostic lifecycle evidence only.

finalLifecycleTrend.reason: Each final attempt has a distinct dataset/source hash.

readinessAssessment.supportedUse: Small-catalog, low-concurrency, human-backed demo or controlled pre-production use.
readinessAssessment.unsupportedClaim: Unattended high-concurrency production readiness, production SLO, online business lift, CSAT/FCR, or unit economics.
